result_text:
Folders named `mock…` or `__mock…` are now test code wherever their name continues, including a bare `mock/`. The change is in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`, in `addMockResourcesConventions()`.

- **Pattern change:** the two folder rules now match any run of characters except a path separator after `mock` or `__mock`, instead of requiring at least one of a fixed set of characters. That covers `mock/`, `mock.data/`, `mock(old)/`, `mock-größe/` and `mock模拟/`. The existing `mockapi`, `*_mock.*` and `[Mm]ocks` rules are unchanged, so `mocks/`, `__mocks__/`, `mock-data/`, `mock_data/`, `mock data/` and `mockStore/` still match.
- **Scope of the match:** the pattern needs a `/` before the folder name and a `/` after it, so `remock/`, `demo/`, `src/main/java/`, `mock.java` and `mockery.java` stay out. Windows paths work through the existing backslash normalisation in `SourceFileFilter.pathMatches`.
- **New test:** `codeanalyzer/src/test/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventionsMockResourcesTest.java` covers the new cases, the previously matched folders and the negative cases. It passes along with the existing `SourceFileFilterTest` (3 and 6 tests, no failures). Run with `mvn -o -pl codeanalyzer test`.

Nothing is committed. The new test file is untracked.
